meta.title: Why Pythagoras Still Runs the Modern World
meta.description: Discover why a 2,500-year-old geometric formula: a squared plus b squared equals c squared: remains the secret engine behind GPS satellites, 3D video game engines, and skyscraper engineering.
facts_to_verify: The Pythagorean Theorem is the foundational distance metric for Euclidean space, used directly in GPS triangulation and 3D graphics dot-product calculations.

scenes.purpose: Hook curiosity by showing how an ancient math formula secretly powers modern skyscrapers and GPS

visual.start: High-altitude view over an illuminated modern suspension bridge at night
visual.action: Bridge cables dissolve into glowing right-angle triangles as structural stress lines illuminate
visual.camera: Rapid fly-through along the bridge suspension cables into the central steel pylon
visual.end: Camera plunges through steel joint into pure geometric coordinate plane

scenes.narration: ढाई हजार साल पुराना एक साधारण फॉर्मूला आज भी दुनिया के हर पुल, गगनचुंबी इमारत और यहाँ तक कि आपके फोन के जी-पी-एस को चला रहा है।

scenes.title: Pythagorean Theorem
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the mathematical formula and square geometric proof with procedural Manim equations

visual.start: Crisp dark blueprint grid with a floating glowing right-angle triangle
visual.action: Squares emerge from all three sides; water-like neon particles from a² and b² pour seamlessly into c²
visual.camera: Direct orthographic zoom centered on the hypotenuse equation
motion_graphics: Bold LaTeX formula overlay: a² + b² = c²
Side length indicator tags: a, b, c
visual.end: Formula locks in brilliant cyan before transitioning to architectural applications

scenes.narration: पाइथागोरस प्रमेय कहता है कि किसी भी समकोण त्रिभुज में आधार और लंब के वर्गों का योग हमेशा कर्ण के वर्ग के बराबर होता है।

scenes.title: Real-World Architecture
scenes.purpose: Provide concrete real-world engineering domains that rely directly on the theorem

visual.start: Three dark glass panels floating in orbital space
visual.action: Cards deploy with snappy staggered entrance on the beat; 3D icons rotate smoothly
visual.camera: Dynamic horizontal panning dolly with depth-of-field shifting across cards
visual.end: Cards slide together into a comparison matrix

scenes.narration: चाहे वीडियो गेम में दो किरदारों के बीच की दूरी नापनी हो, या अंतरिक्ष से जी-पी-एस सैटेलाइट से आपकी लोकेशन पता करनी हो, हर जगह यही सूत्र काम करता है।

scenes.title: 2D Plane vs 3D Reality
scenes.purpose: Explain how the 2D formula extends seamlessly into 3D Euclidean space (x² + y² + z² = d²)

visual.start: Split-screen interface: left shows flat 2D blueprint; right shows volumetric 3D coordinate cube
visual.action: Formula expands from 2 terms on the left to 3 terms on the right as diagonal vector stretches in 3D
visual.camera: Slow orbit around the 3D cube illustrating depth coordinate Z
visual.end: Right side 3D cube sparkles with verification checkmark

scenes.narration: थ्री-डी स्पेस में इसी फॉर्मूले में बस एक तीसरा कोऑर्डिनेट जुड़ जाता है, जिससे पूरी कंप्यूटर ग्राफिक्स की दुनिया खड़ी होती है।

scenes.label: Foundation of Euclidean Distance
scenes.purpose: Deliver impactful takeaway on the universal ubiquity of the formula across physics and computer science

visual.start: Clean dark void with glowing golden compass divider in center
visual.action: Compass rotates 360 degrees drawing a perfect cyan measurement circle; 100% punches forward on the beat
visual.camera: Kinetic punch-in on number 100% with bloom illumination
visual.end: Glyph hovers serenely with soft radial pulse

scenes.narration: सौ प्रतिशत सटीकता के साथ यह फॉर्मूला साबित करता है कि गणित सिर्फ किताबों के लिए नहीं, बल्कि पूरी दुनिया को रचने का कोड है।

scenes.purpose: Inspire the viewer to appreciate math and subscribe for more STEM explanations

visual.start: Golden right triangle transforms into a radiant star beacon
visual.action: Star beacon emits warm golden particle shower; subscribe button slides in with playful spring bounce
visual.camera: Smooth pull-back into atmospheric dark vignette finish

scenes.narration: गणित के ऐसे ही जादुई सिद्धांतों को विज़ुअली समझने के लिए हमें अभी फॉलो करें। मिलते हैं अगले वीडियो में!
